elliot.ops: Heads-up: new hire Priya Nair starts 2025-09-14. She uploaded an Indian passport that expires 2025-09-20 (6 days after start). BG vendor also flagged name format (Priya S. Nair vs Priya Nair). We need remote I-9 plan + BG consent corrected. @zoe.recruiting @jamal.it

zoe.recruiting: Can we accept passport if its valid on the verification date? Candidate prefers a notary; no office visit.

jamal.it: Yes  docs must be unexpired at time of Section 2. Authorized agent (notary) is OK. We require agent printed name, title, company, mailing address, signature, and contact. Scan must be legible.

zoe.recruiting: I'll send candidate a pasteable note and a link to a vendor-assisted notary if needed. Also flagged BG consent for signature update  should be quick.

elliot.ops: Reimburse notary fees per policy? Candidate asked about reimbursement and receipts.

jamal.it: Per onboarding policy we reimburse up to $50 for standard notary fees. Ask candidate to keep receipt and submit via expenses (category: Onboarding). If they prefer no OOP, we can book our partner notary.

bg-bot: BG vendor update: awaiting corrected consent signature. Once received, re-run ETA 24-48h.

i9-bot: Reminder: upload completed Section 2 to https://redwood-secure-intake.example/ within 3 days of verification to avoid delays.

zoe.recruiting: I'll chase Priya for consent and send notary instructions. Draft note for candidate below for copy/paste: 

``
Hi Priya  thanks. Because youre remote you can have a local notary or authorized agent complete Section 2 of Form I-9 on or before 2025-09-14. Ask the agent to inspect your original passport and to print their full name, title, company, mailing address, date, signature, and contact phone/email. Scan or take a clear photo and upload to our secure intake portal: https://redwood-secure-intake.example/. Keep originals for your records. If you pay a notary fee, keep the receipt and submit for reimbursement (up to $50) via expenses.redwood.example. If you prefer, reply and we can book our vendor notary (no out-of-pocket).
```

elliot.ops: Perfect. I'll block virtual Day 1, hold badge/admin until BG green + I-9 verified. :white_check_mark:
